findings.current: Quick to catch on, Gung Gibang understood what I meant and began evacuating the civilians who had been unable to escape and were still sitting on the ground.
findings.defect: The next source sentence says the giant watched Gung Gibang evacuate the civilians, rolling his large eyes from side to side. That physical beat is omitted.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly includes the giant watching the evacuation and moving his eyes; this is a concrete action and characterization detail.
findings.replacement: Quick to catch on, Gung Gibang understood what I meant and began evacuating the civilians who had been unable to escape and were still sitting on the ground. The giant watched him, his huge eyes rolling from side to side.

summary: The translation is broadly faithful, with two minor omissions or reductions in source detail.
